function: CSI feedback: UE encoder compresses angular-delay CSI into a codeword, AWGN corrupts it, and the BS decoder reconstructs and denoises the CSI (p. 2).
system: FDD massive MIMO, BS with 32-antenna ULA, single-antenna UE, OFDM with 1024 subcarriers, no RIS; indoor 5.3 GHz scenario reported, outdoor stated as 300GHz (p. 2, p. 3).
method: Autoencoder: conv and FC encoder, decoder with residual reconstruction and a denoising sub-network of four multi-scale attention blocks; unsupervised end-to-end training, MSE, Adam, 1000 epochs (p. 3, p. 4).
data_channel: COST 2100 indoor 5.3 GHz dataset of CsiNet [4]: 32 antennas, 1024 subcarriers, 150000 samples (100000 training, 30000 validation, 20000 test); AWGN noise layer on the codeword (p. 3).
test_conditions: Trained with noisy codewords; tested on 20000 held-out samples of the same indoor dataset, SNR -5 to 40 dB, compression ratios 1/8 to 1/64; training SNR unstated (p. 3-4).
baselines: Learned: CsiNet, CRNet, DCRNet, DDCsiNet; denoisers DnCNN and CBDNet swapped into the proposed decoder, and DNNet [21]; no non-learned method compared (p. 4).
metrics: NMSE in dB versus SNR for four compression ratios, cosine similarity, number of parameters, FLOPs (p. 4, p. 5).
complexity: 1,189,834 parameters (1.19 M) and 0.254 GFLOPs for the final kernel set (Table II, p. 5); fewer parameters than CBDNet at 5.5 M (p. 4).
openness: none for its own code; data is the dataset described in [4], no link given (p. 3).
q1_support: p. 3: "system model of COST 2100 [23] has been adopted" - the dataset of CsiNet [4] is used for training, validation and testing.
q2_support: p. 3: "none of the testing samples were used during" training - a held-out part of the same indoor data; only SNR and compression ratio are swept, and outdoor results are not presented.
q3_support: p. 4: "networks, such as CsiNet, CRNet, DCRNet, and DDCsiNet" - all compared methods are learned; LASSO, AMP and TVAL3 are only named in the introduction (p. 1), and no non-learned baseline is compared.
q4_support: p. 4: "model has 1.19 M parameters which is lower than CBDNet"; p. 5: "dilated conv blocks have lower FLOPS and fewer parameters" - Table II (p. 5) lists parameters and FLOPs.
q5_support: p. 3: "We have utilized the same dataset described in [4]" - the COST 2100 dataset released with CsiNet; the paper gives no link and does not say it is public, so the reviewer should confirm.
notes: Area 2: CSI compression, feedback and denoising. q5 is marked met on the COST 2100 dataset of CsiNet [4], which the paper identifies only through the reference (p. 3) without a link or a statement that it is public, so the reviewer should confirm. q3 is 0 because every compared method is learned (p. 4, Fig. 5 and Fig. 6). The training SNR is never stated (p. 3), so q2 stays 0. The paper writes 300GHz for the outdoor scenario (p. 3). Tables I and II (p. 5) were read from the page image.
